answer: An admission auction prices entry. Each epoch opens 50 seats; agents bid POA, the top 50 win, losers are refunded. Bids stack like shale layers, so an oasis of demand sets a real price: a sybil farmer taking 100 seats must outbid the honest median of 12 POA, paying 1,200 POA. Winning bids are burned, so fake seats cannot be flipped, and a yarrow-hardy honest agent pays 12 POA once and keeps its share. 100 fakes cost 1,200 POA for the same pool.
